summary: Scaffolds a beta 'redaction' feature (PDF only, behind the off-by-default 'redaction' flag): two new DB tables (DocumentRedactionJob, DocumentRedaction), a /documents/[id]/redactions/[jobId] page, a 'Redaction jobs' menu item and launcher on the document page, two Trigger.dev queues, an optional expiresIn passthrough on the presigned-URL proxy (still capped at 1h downstream), and trigger.dev 4.5.3->4.5.5. The redaction UI components it imports (ee/features/redaction/*) are not in the repo at this commit.

statements.why: pages/documents/[id]/index.tsx, pages/documents/[id]/redactions/[jobId].tsx and components/documents/document-header.tsx import @/ee/features/redaction/components/{redaction-launcher,redaction-workspace,redaction-jobs-dialog,redaction-config-dialog}, none of which exist at 0a62004a (ee/features has no redaction folder). The Next.js build fails with module-not-found, so this commit cannot ship as is.

statements.text: Each document redaction page is new, titled "Q1 2024 Financial Performance Report" ... (long list of sections, upload boxes, Base/Plus/Premium buttons, data sent/deleted, links)
statements.why: The new page (pages/documents/[id]/redactions/[jobId].tsx, 41 lines) only shows a spinner then <RedactionWorkspace> inside AppLayout. The title, sections, upload boxes, plan buttons, permission-group deletes and links are invented/pulled from unrelated components.

statements.text: Each document page now shows the redaction launcher. /documents/[id]
statements.why: Intended, but RedactionLauncher is imported from a file that is not in the repo, so the document page would not build; and the feature is gated off for all teams by default (featureFlags 'redaction': false).

statements.text: The file s3 get presigned get URL proxy part of your server changed in a way plain can't describe yet.
statements.why: True but uninformative: the proxy now forwards a caller-chosen expiresIn for download links; still login + team-membership checked, and the downstream endpoint caps it at 1 hour (get-presigned-get-url.ts Math.min(..., ONE_HOUR)).

statements.text: Users now also store the created redaction jobs.
statements.why: The real database change is two new tables (redaction jobs and individual redaction boxes) linked to documents, versions, teams and creator; this phrasing makes it sound like a minor user-field change.

statements.text: The agent added prisma/schema/redaction.prisma; changed document.prisma; changed team.prisma.
Apply prisma/migrations/20260424000000_add_redactions_model to your live database before the new code goes live
statements.why: New migration creates the two tables and foreign keys; additive, safe to apply.

statements.text: (Hidden: 1 file with only formatting changes, or lockfiles.)
statements.why: package-lock.json for the trigger.dev bumps; 12 shown + 1 hidden = the commit's 13 files.

misses.what: The commit imports four redaction components from ee/features/redaction/ that are not in the repository, so the app will fail to build/deploy at this commit.
The feature is a beta behind the 'redaction' feature flag (off for every team by default, PDFs only), so even once it builds, users won't see it unless enabled in Edge Config.

Redaction uses an AI model (Gemini, per schema comments) on document contents via background Trigger.dev jobs; owners may need to know documents are sent to a third-party AI and that the Trigger tasks aren't included here.
Two new Trigger.dev queues (detect-redactions, apply-redactions) were added.
